name: Capgo Public API
description: Use this API to automate Capgo Cloud instead of clicking through the dashboard. Authenticate every request by sending a Capgo API key in the `x-api-key` header. The legacy `authorization` header (raw key, no Bearer prefix) is still accepted. Standard accounts are limited to 100 requests per minute and enterprise accounts are limited to 1000 requests per minute. Capgo's public API currently uses API-key authentication rather than OAuth or OIDC discovery metadata.
